The claim involves a front nearside collision at low speed in a car park on 14 March 2026 (page 1). The vehicle registration is KP19 TRX, under policy number MOT-4471902 (page 1). The policy covers accidental damage with a limit of GBP 25,000.00 and an excess of GBP 350.00 (page 3). The repair estimate from Northgate Motor Repairs Ltd totals GBP 12,400.00 (page 7), including replacement of the front bumper assembly (GBP 1,850.00), repair and paint of the nearside wing (GBP 2,300.00), replacement of the headlamp unit (GBP 3,150.00), straightening of the radiator support (GBP 1,900.00), and 22 hours of labor at GBP 145 per hour (GBP 3,200.00) (page 7).
